evidence.label: Monitor
evidence.content:
MONITOR · SCALESIGHT + YOUR TEAM
Always watching the signals that matter.

Revenue, demand, inventory, and SKU performance are reviewed together. Material changes are surfaced for analyst attention.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE
A refreshed view of business performance and supply exposure.

evidence.label: Analyze
evidence.content:
ANALYZE · SCALESIGHT + YOUR TEAM
Turn a change into an explanation.

The planning team tests the signal against history, purchase orders, campaigns, and supplier context. Assumptions are explicit and confidence stays qualitative.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE
A business explanation of what changed and why it matters.

evidence.label: Prioritize
evidence.content:
PRIORITIZE · SCALESIGHT + YOUR TEAM
Know which decisions come first.

Timing, cash exposure, and commercial importance determine what needs management attention this week.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE
A short, ordered planning brief with clear decision owners.

evidence.label: Recommend
evidence.content:
RECOMMEND · SCALESIGHT + YOUR TEAM
Every insight has a next step.

The team prepares purchasing actions, demand scenarios, and commercial trade-offs. Every recommendation includes the change, meaning, action, and decision required.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE
Considered actions and scenario analysis on demand.

evidence.label: Review
evidence.content:
REVIEW · SCALESIGHT + YOUR TEAM
Make the decision with your team.

A planning review brings your business context into the model. Decisions update the assumptions, and the next monitoring cycle begins.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE
Strategic guidance and ongoing decision support.
